description: AlphaFold v6 model of LONRF2: per-region pLDDT and zinc-site ligand geometry for both RINGs
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json

meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q1L5Z9",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb_url=meta.get("pdbUrl"); print("model:",meta["modelEntityId"],"v",meta["latestVersion"],"global pLDDT",meta["globalMetricValue"])
print(pdb_url)
pdb=requests.get(pdb_url,timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        rows.append((l[12:16].strip(), l[17:20].strip(), int(l[22:26]),
                     float(l[30:38]), float(l[38:46]), float(l[46:54]), float(l[60:66])))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["aname","res","resi","x","y","z","b"])
print("atoms",len(D),"residues",D["resi"].max())
ca=D[D["aname"]=="CA"].set_index("resi")["b"]

regions={"N-RING core 143-170":(143,170),"N-RING L6-L8 loop 167-196":(167,196),
         "N-RING module 134-196":(134,196),"C-RING 449-490":(449,490),
         "TPR 197-298":(197,298),"Lon-N 528-737":(528,737),"whole":(1,754)}
print("\npLDDT by region:")
for k,(a,b) in regions.items():
    v=ca.loc[a:b]; print(f"  {k:26s} mean={v.mean():6.1f}  min={v.min():5.1f}  frac>70={100*(v>70).mean():5.1f}%")

def lig(resi):
    s=D[D["resi"]==resi]; rn=s["res"].iloc[0]
    if rn=="CYS": sel=s[s["aname"]=="SG"]
    elif rn=="HIS": sel=s[s["aname"]=="NE2"]
    else: sel=s[s["aname"]=="CB"]
    return rn, sel[["x","y","z"]].values[0]

SITES={"C-RING site I (C449,C452,C469,C472)":[449,452,469,472],
       "C-RING site II (C464,H466,C483,C486)":[464,466,483,486],
       "N-RING site I (C143,C146,C163,C166)":[143,146,163,166],
       "N-RING site II (C158,L160,C190,C195)":[158,160,190,195],
       "N-RING site II, Cys only (C158,C190,C195)":[158,190,195]}
res_sum=[]
print("\n=== ligand-atom clustering in the AlphaFold model ===")
for lab,ris in SITES.items():
    pts=[];nm=[]
    for ri in ris:
        rn,p=lig(ri); pts.append(p); nm.append(f"{rn}{ri}")
    pts=np.array(pts); n=len(pts)
    M=np.sqrt(((pts[:,None]-pts[None])**2).sum(-1)); iu=np.triu_indices(n,1)
    cen=pts.mean(0); rad=np.sqrt(((pts-cen)**2).sum(1))
    print(f"\n{lab}")
    print("  "+", ".join(f"{nm[i]}-{nm[j]}={M[i,j]:.2f}" for i,j in zip(*iu)))
    print(f"  mean={M[iu].mean():.2f} A  max={M[iu].max():.2f} A  centroid radius mean={rad.mean():.2f} A  pLDDT={ca.loc[ris].mean():.0f}")
    res_sum.append(dict(site=lab,n=n,mean_pair=round(float(M[iu].mean()),2),max_pair=round(float(M[iu].max()),2),
                        centroid_radius=round(float(rad.mean()),2),mean_pLDDT=round(float(ca.loc[ris].mean()),1)))
T=pd.DataFrame(res_sum); print("\n"+T.to_string(index=False)); T.to_csv("LONRF2_AF_zincsite_geometry.csv",index=False)
print("\nBenchmark: a genuine Zn(Cys)4 / Zn(Cys)3His centre has ligand-ligand distances 3.4-4.2 A")
print("and a centroid radius ~2.2-2.5 A (ligand atom to Zn ~2.3 A).")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.3))
ax[0].plot(ca.index, ca.values, lw=0.7, color="#333")
for (a,b),c,lab in [((134,196),"#d95f02","N-RING-like"),((449,490),"#1b9e77","C-RING"),((528,737),"#7570b3","Lon-N")]:
    ax[0].axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=0.3,label=lab)
ax[0].axhline(70,ls=":",c="grey"); ax[0].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right"); ax[0].set_title("AlphaFold confidence, human LONRF2")
sub=T[T["n"]==4]
ax[1].bar(range(4), sub["max_pair"], color=["#1b9e77","#1b9e77","#d95f02","#d95f02"])
ax[1].axhspan(3.4,4.2,color="grey",alpha=0.3)
ax[1].text(3.45,4.3,"Zn site range",ha="right",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax[1].set_xticks(range(4)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(["C-RING\nsite I","C-RING\nsite II","N-RING\nsite I","N-RING\nsite II"],fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("max ligand-ligand distance (A)")
ax[1].set_title("Candidate zinc sites, AlphaFold geometry")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
